title: Attunement KPI mini-journal — weekly checkpoints and experiments
content:
Purpose and framing:

This is a lightweight, living scratchpad to keep my personal KPI focus aligned with what actually moves product work and learning. The word 'attunement' is a reminder: tune small controls (habits, prompts, micro-experiments) and observe signal, not just chase vanity metrics.

How I use this doc (workflow):
- Monday morning: quick pulse (3 min) — update numbers, set 1 micro-experiment for the week.
- Midweek: 5–10 min check — note deviations and blockers.
- Friday retro: 10–15 min — capture outcomes, surprises, next-step hypotheses.
- Keep it short: each week <= 300 words in the log entry.

Primary personal KPIs I’m tracking (for Q1–Q2 product sprints):
- Dev throughput: merged PRs touching serving-runtime or prompt-evals (goal: 6/week).
- Prompt quality signal: median eval score on weekly test set (goal: >= 82).
- Latency regression checks: % requests < 150ms p50 (goal: 95%).
- Experiment velocity: number of distinct prompt/eval experiments launched (goal: 3/month).
- Energy/habit metric: days with >90 focused minutes of deep work (goal: 4/week).

This week's snapshot (2026-03-09 to 2026-03-13):
- Merged PRs: 4 (two infra, two eval harness updates) — short of 6.
- Prompt median eval: 80 (drop driven by corner-case refilling behaviour).
- Latency p50: 142ms (within goal; p95 spiked to 420ms on one test run).
- Experiments launched: 1 (prefix caching tweak + ablation).
- Focus days: 3

Micro-experiment (this week): prefix-cache TTL heuristic tweak
- Hypothesis: small TTL (50 tokens) for session-level prefixes will reduce unnecessary KV cache churn and improve p95 on mixed short/long request distributions.
- Planned measurement: run 2 A/B eval runs on the Canary pool (perf + cost), track p50/p95 and median eval score.
- Success metric: p95 improves by >10% with no >1 point drop in median eval.

Observations / quick notes:
- The p95 spike correlated with a background garbage-collection job in the canary infra; need to coordinate with infra team before concluding the TTL change is sole cause.
- The prompt-eval drop looks concentrated on the "refill-by-default" scenario — I added 20 failing prompts to the deck for deeper inspection.
- I forgot to tag the JIRA ticket for the KV cache change; created JIRA-ENG-2241 and linked PR.

Action items (next 7 days):
- Short: finish RFC note for prefix-TTL experiments and post as comment on PR (due: 2026-03-14).
- Short: sync with SRE (Ibrahim) about nightly GC window and potential isolation (due: 2026-03-15).
- Medium: add 100 prompt cases to the "refill" evaluation set and re-run batch (due: 2026-03-20).
- Personal: protect two 90-minute deep-work slots on Tue/Thu to hit focus goal.

Retrospective quick-looks (past 4 weeks):
- What worked: small safe experiments (canary-only) let us iterate without broad customer impact; observed clear cost signal.
- What didn’t: experiment throughput bottleneck — manual wiring for dataset variants slowed iterations. Need templated harness.
- Biggest open risk: conflating infra noise (GC windows, node restarts) with model/regression signals. Need better tagging in logs and a pre-check harness to flag infra events before labeling an experiment failure.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Can I automate the "pre-check" to fail fast if infra noise > threshold? (idea: quick health probe run first; if p95 increases > 2x during health probe, postpone experiment.)
- Is the experiment deck overfitting to short sequences? Add stratified bins by sequence length.
- Energy: are 90-min blocks enough or do I need 2x45-min blocks? Try both for two weeks and record cognitive load.

Snippets / useful links for quick paste: 
- RFC stub: "prefix-ttl-experiment-2026-03" (link: CONFLUENCE-7642)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/internal/prompt-evals/pull/89
- JIRA: JIRA-ENG-2241

Weekly log entries (brief):
- 2026-03-06: Good momentum. Shipped small eval harness change. Noticed flaky p95 on canary — flagged.
- 2026-03-13: Deployed TTL tweak to canary. Observed modest p95 improvement after infra job reschedule. Need more runs.

Experiment templates to build (todo list):
- 1-page experiment checklist: pre-checks, infra gating, measurement window, rollback criteria.
- Automated stratified run generator: pull N prompts stratified by sequence length and user-intent tag.
- Post-run artifact collector: single dashboard with eval metrics + infra timeline overlays.

Closing thought for sprint: small habits + disciplined pre-checks reduce churn of false negatives. Attunement wins if I *measure more carefully* before declaring a regression.

End of entry (Ella)
